content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, supporting diagnosis codes I34.0 and R00.2. As stated in the order, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities. Because the service meets the medical necessity described in this indication, we request that the authorization-based denial be overturned and the claim be processed for the outstanding balance of 599.38."}
